title: Build This Expression Challenge
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Given a target named expression from this chapter's core set, demonstrate mastery of its parameter recipe by constructing it with sliders — adjusting eyebrow angle, eye size, pupil position, and mouth curvature until the rendered face matches the target's defining features.

learningObjectives: Given a target named expression from this chapter's core set, demonstrate mastery of its parameter recipe by constructing it with sliders — adjusting eyebrow angle, eye size, pupil position, and mouth curvature until the rendered face matches the target's defining features.
